description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kotadalupotha, Redeegama D/S Division, Kurunegala District  - Cad. Map No. 420106
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed ownership information, property descriptions, and legal encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and property title matters, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
